name: The Meridian Wire
description: An independent licensed news program operating under a narrow editorial charter negotiated with the Meridian Municipal Authority — one of the last independently licensed news operations in the city. The Wire covers Tier 2 and Tier 3 civic affairs, labor disputes, and municipal infrastructure with genuine adversarial journalism, constrained by what its charter legally permits. Its senior correspondent, Adaeze Fontaine-Mwangi, has been sued by corponations eleven times; she has never lost.
cultural_impact: The Meridian Wire is the only licensed news operation in GLMZ that Tier 1 underground journalists consider partially trustworthy, creating an unusual bridge between above-ground and mesh-distributed information ecosystems.
story_hooks: Adaeze Fontaine-Mwangi has obtained documentation that would end the Vantablack licensing case — and destroy her show's operating charter permanently if she runs it.
The Wire's charter has a hidden clause, unknown even to its editorial staff, that gives a specific corponation a prior-review right over certain categories of story.
Someone is leaking Wire story leads to Axiom Corp Security before broadcast — the mole could be anyone from a junior researcher to the show's municipal charter liaison.
